pythonFunction.name: get_billing_history
pythonFunction.description:
Returns the customer's most recent billing periods (dates, days, amount, usage, read type). Use
it for questions about past bills. Needs an identified caller. Before calling this tool, speak a
brief conversational pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    account_id: Account id of the identified account (REQUIRED).
    periods: How many recent periods to return, 1 to 13.
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok and periods (newest first), each with period, start, end, days, amount,
    usage, unit, read_type and rate_per_unit.
